friendly_name: Day-specific habit scheduling with auto-skip on miss
source_description: Day-specific habit tasks (e.g., 'Strength training — Wednesday', 'Strength training — Friday') currently appear in the felix-admin-habits morning check-in on every day of the week, not just on their designated weekday. Root cause: when a day-specific habit's due_date falls in the past (because Kent missed it), it satisfies the `due_date <= today AND done=false` filter every day thereafter. This mission constrains day-specific habits to only appear on their designated weekday, and auto-marks them as missed (with history log + advance to next designated weekday) at end-of-ET-day if not completed.
